activity.notes: 1667 is the personal, source-attested Medway raid representative point under Admiral Michiel de Ruyter. It is not his complete naval career or a claim that the Kingdom of the Netherlands existed in 1667. Death 1676 documented by Royal Museums Greenwich.

sources.title: Royal Museums Greenwich — Dutch Attack on the Medway, June 1667
sources.citation_text: Royal Museums Greenwich explicitly identifies Lieutenant-Admiral de Ruyter as Dutch commander of the successful 1667 Medway raid.

sources.title: Royal Museums Greenwich — Lieutenant-Admiral Michiel de Ruyter (1607–1676)
sources.citation_text: Historic collection attests the admiral's personal identity, lifetime and victories in the Second Anglo-Dutch War.

spatial_disposition.evidence: Medway campaign and Dutch Republic affiliation documented; do not invent precise personal place coordinates or period PlaceFunction identity.
